title: registry.json
description: Shulker's index of the instances it keeps in sync, kept beside config.json. Written by shulker and safe to delete: `shulker instances repair` rebuilds it by scanning the launchers. Each instance's own settings live in its .shulker/instance.json, not here.

$schema.description: Always https://shulker.sh/schema/v1/registry.json. A registry that names a schema shulker doesn't know is refused rather than rewritten; `shulker instances repair` replaces it.

instances.description: One row per instance shulker knows about.

id.description: Unique short name for this instance, and what `-i` takes. Slugified from the instance's name unless `--as` picked it.

name.description: The name the launcher shows. Set by `--name`, and what shulker calls the instance in its own output.

launcher.description: Which launcher owns the instance: prism, multimc, mojang, atlauncher, or gdlauncher. Empty for a directory shulker only syncs into.

launcherDir.description: The launcher's own data directory. Kept here rather than in the instance, because `unlink` needs it exactly when the instance directory is gone.

dir.description: The instance directory: the game directory the launcher runs, holding its .shulker/instance.json.

source.description: Where the instance syncs from, as recorded in its instance.json.

lastError.description: Why the last sync failed, if it did. Cleared by the next sync that works.
